query: Test the app on the emulator
expected_behavior: Fetches from origin and confirms the branch is up to date before building
Runs scripts/emulator.sh, then scripts/install.sh debug --fresh, without reading the scripts first
Covers at least home, a level won and a level lost, the daily puzzle and Settings from reference/test-plan.md, reading a screenshot of each screen
Ends with the report table, including a 'Not tested' line

query: I'm about to upload to Play. Check the release build works on the simulator.
expected_behavior: Installs with scripts/install.sh release --fresh (R8 build signed with the debug key), not the debug build
Runs the smoke test, including a relaunch to check saved progress and process death on the game screen
Runs scripts/check_crash.sh release after each flow and reports any SerializationException or ClassNotFoundException as an R8 problem
Does not tap the real ads of the release build

query: Check on my phone that the game screen isn't under the status bar any more
expected_behavior: Connects the Pixel 10 with adb mdns services and adb connect <ip:port>, and sets ANDROID_SERIAL to it
Falls back to the emulator (emulator-5554) and says so if the phone can't be reached
Opens a game with `android input tap text=Play`, captures a screenshot and reads it, checking the top bar against the status bar and the banner against the gesture bar
